data.name: Steelers Kick Off 2026 with 20-13 Win Over Falcons, Powered by Watt's Pick-Six
data.summary: The Steelers beat the Atlanta Falcons 20-13 at Acrisure Stadium on Sunday, improving to 1-0 under new coach Mike McCarthy while the Falcons dropped to 0-1 in Kevin Stefanski's debut. Atlanta's Bijan Robinson rushed for 173 yards and a touchdown, but turnovers proved too costly against a dominant Steelers unit that turned mistakes into points despite some offensive penalties.

data.summary: Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., healthy despite a summer back injury, was ruled inactive for the season opener against the Atlanta Falcons due to an impasse in extension negotiations. The team has halted discussions per their policy against regular-season deals, fueling trade rumors as Porter is open to other teams and Pittsburgh has fielded offers. Fans point fingers at his representation or the club's recent extensions for other young players like Keeanu Benton and Nick Herbig, while the Steelers won 20-13 on T.J. Watt's pick-six.

The team elevated linebacker Nathaniel Watson and cornerback D’Angelo Ross from the practice squad, keeping backup Shedeur Sanders ready while saving Green's athleticism for a true crisis.
